gaps: No layer tree: no CALayer, sublayers, delegate or layout managers for apps (views only).
No keyframe, group or additive animations, and no key-path animations (typed view properties only).
No transform, corner radius, shadow or mask on views; no 3D transforms.
No shape layer (Bezier paths, stroke and fill rule) and no gradient layer in the SDK.
No display-link object and no frame-rate preference (CAFrameRateRange).
No replicator or particle layers (CAReplicatorLayer, CAEmitterLayer).
No app-facing Metal layer or drawable (CAMetalLayer, CAMetalDrawable); the compositor is system-only.
Springs do not carry velocity into a retarget (springboard/ui/src/anim.rs).
Transitions (CATransition) are private to Settings, Files and the shell, not an SDK API.
